title: setRatio accepts ratio == MAX_RATIO, contradicting documented strict-less-than invariant
description: setRatio uses 'if (newRatio > MAX_RATIO) revert' (BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook.sol:93) while the NatSpec/invariant states strictly < MAX_RATIO (=50) (lines 29, 47, 91); ratio==50 is wrongly accepted, contradicting the documented bound.
impact: None. Spec/code deviation only; the downstream truncation in added = amount * ratio / 100 rounds in the harmless direction.
attackPath: setRatio uses 'if (newRatio > MAX_RATIO) revert' (BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook.sol:93) while NatSpec/invariant states strictly < MAX_RATIO=50 (lines 29,47,91); ratio==50 is wrongly accepted.
recommendation: Change the guard to 'if (newRatio >= MAX_RATIO) revert' to match the documented strictly-less-than invariant, or update the NatSpec to permit equality if equality is actually intended.
justification: Genuine spec-vs-code deviation of a stated invariant with no asset impact -> Low (state/spec correctness). Owner-set parameter, but the issue is correctness of the documented bound, not owner abuse.
